name: nexus-backend-architecture
description: NEXUS Architecture - Neural Enterprise eXecution & Unified System. A neural-inspired backend framework with distributed intelligence and CRM integration.

scripts.restart: npm run down && sleep 2 && npm run up
scripts.status: ps aux | grep 'nexus-core' | grep -v grep || echo 'NEXUS: Offline'
scripts.ports: lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | grep node || echo 'No Node.js processes'
scripts.info: echo '🧠 NEXUS Info:' && node -v && npm -v && echo 'Platform:' $(uname -a)
scripts.health: npm run port && npm run redis && npm run status
scripts.clear: npm run kill && npm run clean && npm run logs
scripts.reset: npm run down && npm run clear && npm run fresh && npm run up
scripts.crm-test:
npm run crm && echo '
---' && npm run crm-leads
scripts.scan: npm audit && echo '🔒 Security scan complete'
scripts.check: npm run info && npm run health && npm run outdated && npm run crm
scripts.emergency: npm run killall && npm run clear && npm run up
scripts.maintain: npm run down && npm run update && npm run fix && npm run up
